suggestions.reason: The baseline run for this eval reached the same conclusion and additionally found something this with-skill run did not surface: the --full-cutflow output's 'track_fiducialECAL' row is a different, static NanoAOD branch (isFiducialECALTrack) unrelated to the dynamic lepton hot-spot maps, meaning there is no existing diagnostic row that reveals whether the maps loaded. That's a real gap in the disapptrks-signal-acceptance skill's own guidance worth adding.

eval_feedback.overall: All 4 expectations pass. The skill correctly steered the agent to the right invariant and check, but the baseline run (see its own grading.json) went one level deeper into the code and found a genuine documentation gap the skill should incorporate.
